answer.worked:
Both logarithmic arguments must be positive, so $x>1$.

At $P$, the two functions have equal values.
$$\begin{align*}
\log_2(x-1)+\log_2(2x-1)&=0\\
\log_2\bigl((x-1)(2x-1)\bigr)&=0\\
(x-1)(2x-1)&=1\\
2x^2-3x+1&=1\\
2x^2-3x&=0\\
x(2x-3)&=0\\
x&=0\text{ or }\frac32
\end{align*}$$
Only $x=\frac32$ satisfies $x>1$.
$$\begin{align*}
y&=\log_2\left(\frac32-1\right)\\
y&=-1
\end{align*}$$
Hence $P=\left(\frac32,-1\right)$.
